instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: Set `dir='rtl'` on html element and body text alignment to right.
Import Arabic Google Fonts in index.html or index.css (@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cairo:wght@400;600;700;800;900&family=Changa:wght@500;700;800&display=swap')).
Use custom cyberpunk style classes for neon borders, glitch headings, and scanline overlays.
Always provide realistic mock data for members, applications, ranks, and points so the platform feels fully populated and responsive.
Add toast feedback via `sonner` for all application submissions, admin approvals/rejections, rules updates, and point changes.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit `data-testid` attributes as listed in `testing_attributes`.
